name: Mahashivratri
description: The great night of Shiva celebrating cosmic balance and meditation.

name: Janmashtami
description: Celebrating the birth of Lord Krishna in joy and love.

name: Navratri
description: Nine nights dedicated to the forms of Divine Mother Durga.

name: Ram Navami
description: Celebrating the descent of Lord Rama's righteousness.

name: Hanuman Jayanti
description: Commemorating the birth of Lord Hanuman, the peak of devotion.

name: Diwali
description: Festival of lights, welcoming prosperity, wisdom, and peace.
